parameters.name: CommandId
parameters.description:
The ID of the command to be approved for execution.
> You can call the [ListApproveCommands](~~2584310~~) operation to query all command IDs that require approval.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
